scenes.vo: Welcome to Field O S. In the next two minutes, here's how to run your sites from your phone.

title: All your sites
in one list.
bullets: Tap New project to add a site
scenes.vo: When you open Field O S, you see all your sites. Tap New project to add one, with the client's name and dates. A red tag shows when tasks are running late.

title: Know what's
on time.
bullets: Late tasks show a finish forecast
scenes.vo: Inside a site, the Tasks tab shows overall progress, and every task with its start and due dates. Late tasks are marked, with a forecast of when they'll finish.

title: Speak the
day's work.
bullets: Talk in Telugu, Hindi or English
scenes.vo: At the end of the day, open D P R and tap Speak report. Say what happened in your own language, and Field O S writes the daily report. Then share it as a P D F on WhatsApp.

title: Problems get
fixed.
scenes.vo: Problems you mention become issues, with a priority, so they're fixed, not forgotten.

title: Attendance in
seconds.
bullets: Mark many for the whole gang
scenes.vo: In Labour, tap Punch in for one worker, or Mark many for the whole gang. Set the site area once, and every punch is checked with G P S.

title: Saturday wages,
worked out.
bullets: What is still due to each worker
scenes.vo: The wage sheet adds up days, half days and overtime for the week, and shows what's still due to each worker. Share it in one tap.

title: Received, spent,
balance.
scenes.vo: Money shows what the client paid, what the site spent, and the balance. Tap Add expense to record a bill in seconds.

title: See stock before
you order.
scenes.vo: Under Procure, the Stock tab shows each material received and used, so you know what's left before you order more.
Finally, a few things for the owner.

title: Every budget
at a glance.
scenes.vo: The dashboard compares each site's spending with its budget, and tells you which sites are close to budget, or already over it.

title: Approve from
anywhere.
scenes.vo: Purchases and overruns wait in Approvals. Approve or reject them from anywhere.

title: Checklists
on site.
scenes.vo: And run quality and safety checklists right on site.
Field O S works without network, in English, Hindi and Telugu. Start your free three-day trial today.
scenes.title: Start your free 3-day trial
scenes.sub: Works offline. English, Hindi and Telugu.
